• Competing in the Phoenix Races at Brighton on 8th November, Adam Jones placed 3rd in the Youths 4k event in 12:10 while James Drake was 5th in the Boys race in 10:16.
Our Under 15 Boys had started the medal spree by gaining an unexpected second team place, both Simon Alexander and James Drake running very confidently.
With Belgrave running out winners in the U17 and U15 categories, and James Drake picking up fastest lap of the day in the younger group, what more could you ask from the opening winter fixture.
Sussex based Gavin Jones was in the pack after the first circuit, handing over to a determined James Drake and we were up to 9th by mid-way.

Other good signs were the continuing metamorphosis of Alex Druce from jogger to serious track man, and the emergence of young talent prepared to have a go in senior competition in the form of James Drake.
Simon Alexander ran 6:09 for 2nd on leg one and we never slipped out of that position as Kevin Quinn (6:17) and James Drake (6:24) finished off.
